HARBOUR LIGHTS
You're invited

Dear friend, thank you for being part of the Harbour Lights family this year. Your support helped us bring music to the waterfront again, and we could not have done it without you. This autumn we wanted to do something special to say thank you, so we have planned an evening that we hope you will remember for a long time.

The city orchestra will play music from films and old songs everyone knows, under the lights of the old harbour. The concert is on Friday 9 October at 19:00, and the doors open one hour before. Warm drinks will be served on the pier, and blankets are free for anyone who needs one.

Seats are limited, so please book early.
